functions.name: AppActivate
functions.signature: AppActivate(Title As Variant, [Wait As Variant])

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Required. String expression specifying the title in the title bar of the application window you want to activate. The task ID returned by the Shell function can be used in place of _title_ to activate an application.

parameters.name: Wait
parameters.description: Optional. Boolean value specifying whether the calling application has the focus before activating another. If False (default), the specified application is immediately activated, even if the calling application does not have the focus. If True, the calling application waits until it has the focus, and then activates the specified application.

functions.name: Beep
functions.signature: Beep()
functions.description: Sounds a tone through the computer's speaker.

functions.name: CreateObject
functions.signature: CreateObject(Class As String, [ServerName As String]) As Variant
functions.description: Creates and returns a reference to an ActiveX object.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Required; Variant (String). The application name and class of the object to create.

parameters.name: ServerName
parameters.description: Optional; Variant (String). The name of the network server where the object will be created. If _servername_ is an empty string (""), the local machine is used.

functions.name: DoEvents
functions.signature: DoEvents() As Integer
functions.description: Yields execution so that the operating system can process other events.

functions.name: GetObject
functions.signature: GetObject([PathName As Variant], [Class As Variant]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a reference to an object provided by an ActiveX component.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description: Optional; Variant (String). The full path and name of the file containing the object to retrieve. If _pathname_ is omitted, _class_ is required.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Optional; Variant (String). A string representing the class of the object.

functions.name: InputBox
functions.signature: InputBox(Prompt As Variant, [Title As Variant], [Default As Variant], [XPos As Variant], [YPos As Variant], [HelpFile As Variant], [Context As Variant]) As String
functions.description: Displays a prompt in a dialog box, waits for the user to input text or click a button, and returns a String containing the contents of the text box.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: Required. String expression displayed as the message in the dialog box. The maximum length of _prompt_ is approximately 1024 characters, depending on the width of the characters used. If _prompt_ consists of more than one line, you can separate the lines by using a carriage return character (Chr(13)), a linefeed character (Chr(10)), or carriage return-linefeed character combination ((Chr(13) & (Chr(10)) between each line.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Optional. String expression displayed in the title bar of the dialog box. If you omit _title_, the application name is placed in the title bar.

parameters.name: Default
parameters.description: Optional. String expression displayed in the text box as the default response if no other input is provided. If you omit _default_, the text box is displayed empty.

parameters.name: XPos
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that specifies, in twips, the horizontal distance of the left edge of the dialog box from the left edge of the screen. If _xpos_ is omitted, the dialog box is horizontally centered.

parameters.name: YPos
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that specifies, in twips, the vertical distance of the upper edge of the dialog box from the top of the screen. If _ypos_ is omitted, the dialog box is vertically positioned approximately one-third of the way down the screen.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: Optional. String expression that identifies the Help file to use to provide context-sensitive Help for the dialog box. If _helpfile_ is provided, _context_ must also be provided.

parameters.name: Context
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that is the Help context number assigned to the appropriate Help topic by the Help author. If _context_ is provided, _helpfile_ must also be provided.

functions.name: MsgBox
functions.signature: MsgBox(Prompt As Variant, [Buttons As VbMsgBoxStyle], [Title As Variant], [HelpFile As Variant], [Context As Variant]) As VbMsgBoxResult
functions.description: Displays a message in a dialog box, waits for the user to click a button, and returns an Integer indicating which button the user clicked.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: Required. String expression displayed as the message in the dialog box. The maximum length of _prompt_ is approximately 1024 characters, depending on the width of the characters used. If _prompt_ consists of more than one line, you can separate the lines by using a carriage return character (Chr(13)), a linefeed character (Chr(10)), or carriage return - linefeed character combination (Chr(13) & Chr(10)) between each line.

parameters.name: Buttons
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that is the combination of values specifying the number and type of buttons to display, the icon style to use, the identity of the default button, and the modality of the message box. If omitted, the default value for _buttons_ is 0.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Optional. String expression displayed in the title bar of the dialog box. If you omit _title_, the application name is placed in the title bar.

parameters.name: HelpFile
parameters.description: Optional. String expression that identifies the Help file to use to provide context-sensitive Help for the dialog box. If _helpfile_ is provided, _context_ must also be provided.

parameters.name: Context
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that is the Help context number assigned to the appropriate Help topic by the Help author. If _context_ is provided, _helpfile_ must also be provided.

functions.name: SendKeys
functions.signature: SendKeys(String As String, [Wait As Variant])
functions.description: Sends one or more keystrokes to the active window as if typed at the keyboard.

parameters.name: String
parameters.description: Required. String expression specifying the keystrokes to send.

parameters.name: Wait
parameters.description: Optional. Boolean value specifying the wait mode. If False (default), control is returned to the procedure immediately after the keys are sent. If True, keystrokes must be processed before control is returned to the procedure.

functions.name: Shell
functions.signature: Shell(PathName As Variant, [WindowStyle As VbAppWinStyle]) As Double
functions.description: Runs an executable program and returns a Variant (Double) representing the program's task ID if successful; otherwise, it returns zero.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description: Required; Variant (String). Name of the program to execute and any required arguments or command-line switches; may include directory or folder and drive. On the Macintosh, you can use the MacID function to specify an application's signature instead of its name. The following example uses the signature for Microsoft Word: Shell MacID("MSWD")

parameters.name: WindowStyle
parameters.description: Optional. Variant (Integer) corresponding to the style of the window in which the program is to be run. If _windowstyle_ is omitted, the program is started minimized with focus. On the Macintosh (System 7.0 or later), _windowstyle_ only determines whether or not the application gets the focus when it is run.

functions.name: Partition
functions.signature: Partition(Number As Variant, Start As Variant, Stop As Variant, Interval As Variant) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (String) indicating where a number occurs within a calculated series of ranges.

parameters.name: Number
parameters.description: Required. The number that you want to evaluate against the ranges.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Required. The number that is the start of the overall range of numbers. The number can't be less than 0.

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description: Required. The number that is the end of the overall range of numbers. The number can't be equal to or less than _start_.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: Required. The number that is the difference between one range and the next. The number can't be less than 1.

functions.name: Choose
functions.signature: Choose(Index As Single, Choice As SAFEARRAY(Variant)) As Variant
functions.description: Selects and returns a value from a list of arguments.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Required. Numeric expression or field that results in a value between 1 and the number of available choices.

parameters.name: Choice
parameters.description: Required. Variant expression containing one of the possible choices.

functions.name: GetSetting
functions.signature: GetSetting(AppName As String, Section As String, Key As String, [Default As Variant]) As String
functions.description: Returns a key setting value from an application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the application or project whose key setting is requested. On the Macintosh, this is the filename of the initialization file in the Preferences folder in the System folder.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the section where the key setting is found.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the key setting to return.

parameters.name: Default
parameters.description: Optional. Expression containing the value to return if no value is set in the key setting. If omitted, _default_ is assumed to be a zero-length string ("").

functions.name: SaveSetting
functions.signature: SaveSetting(AppName As String, Section As String, Key As String, Setting As String)
functions.description: Saves or creates an application entry in the application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the application or project to which the setting applies. On the Macintosh, this is the filename of the initialization file in the Preferences folder in the System folder.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the section where the key setting is being saved.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the key setting being saved.

parameters.name: Setting
parameters.description: Required. Expression containing the value that _key_ is being set to.

functions.name: DeleteSetting
functions.signature: DeleteSetting(AppName As String, [Section As Variant], [Key As Variant])
functions.description: Deletes a section or key setting from an application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the application or project to which the section or key setting applies. On the Macintosh, this is the filename of the initialization file in the Preferences folder in the System folder.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the section where the key setting is being deleted. If only _appname_ and _section_ are provided, the specified section is deleted along with all related key settings.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Optional. String expression containing the name of the key setting being deleted.

functions.name: GetAllSettings
functions.signature: GetAllSettings(AppName As String, Section As String) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a list of key settings and their respective values (originally created with SaveSetting) from an application's entry in the Windows registry or (on the Macintosh) information in the application's initialization file.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the application or project whose key settings are requested. On the Macintosh, this is the filename of the initialization file in the Preferences folder in the System folder.

parameters.name: Section
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing the name of the section whose key settings are requested. GetAllSettings returns a Variant whose contents is a two-dimensional array of strings containing all the key settings in the specified section and their corresponding values.

functions.name: CallByName
functions.signature: CallByName(Object As Object, ProcName As String, CallType As VbCallType, Args As SAFEARRAY(Variant), lcid As Long) As Variant
functions.description: Executes a method of an object, or sets or returns a property of an object.

parameters.name: Object
parameters.description: Required: Variant (Object). The name of the object on which the function will be executed.

parameters.name: ProcName
parameters.description: Required: Variant (String). A string expression containing the name of a property or method of the object.

parameters.name: CallType
parameters.description: Required: Constant. A constant of type vbCallType representing the type of procedure being called.
